# OpenCode Go evidence snapshots

Immutable phase-15 source-only evidence snapshots, copied byte-for-byte from
`15-EVIDENCE.md` and `15-EDGE-COVERAGE.json` before milestone archiving.
Relative research references in the snapshot refer to the historical phase-15
artifacts, not files in this fixture directory. They are not network lookups.

These inputs keep the exact-tuple and mutation regressions independent of the
active planning directory. No assertion, candidate, admission, or unresolved
evidence status was changed. Current release claims remain in
`docs/provider-release-evidence.md`; these snapshots are not live verification.
